# QueryResult

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryResult`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Represents the result of a query execution against Dataverse. Contains the records, column metadata, and paging information.


```text
System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList`1<PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryColumn> Columns { get; set; }
```

Metadata about the columns in the result set.


#### Records

```text
System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList`1<System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyDictionary`2<System.String,PPDS.Dataverse.Query.QueryValue>> Records { get; set; }
```

The records returned by the query. Each record is a dictionary mapping column names to their values.


#### Count

```text
System.Int32 Count { get; set; }
```

The number of records in this result page.


#### PageNumber

```text
System.Int32 PageNumber { get; set; }
```

The current page number (1-based).


#### ExecutionTimeMs

```text
System.Int64 ExecutionTimeMs { get; set; }
```

The time taken to execute the query.


#### TotalCount

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> TotalCount { get; set; }
```

The total number of records matching the query, if count was requested. Only populated when the query includes returntotalrecordcount.


#### EntityLogicalName

```text
System.String EntityLogicalName { get; set; }
```

The logical name of the primary entity being queried.


#### ExecutedFetchXml

```text
System.String ExecutedFetchXml { get; set; }
```

The FetchXML that was actually executed. For SQL queries, this is the transpiled FetchXML.


#### PagingCookie

```text
System.String PagingCookie { get; set; }
```

The paging cookie for fetching the next page of results. Pass this to the next query execution to continue.
